basic_info: 62-year-old male presenting with chest pain over the weekend
present_illness: Chest pain lasting approximately one hour, with associated shortness of breath and discomfort. The chest pain occurred during yard work in hot weather. It was located in the chest, felt like pressure, and did not radiate. The shortness of breath started at the same time as the chest pain and lasted for about an hour. No other symptoms were reported apart from shortness of breath and discomfort.
past_history: No prior cardiac evaluations or tests for chest pain (e.g., ECG, stress test, cardiac enzymes). No history of cardiovascular conditions (hypertension, hyperlipidemia, diabetes, coronary artery disease). No medications or allergies. Family history of heart disease on cousin's side.
physical_exam: Physical examination findings: Enlarged non-tender thyroid, right carotid bruit, clear lungs, regular heart rate and rhythm with a 3/6 systolic ejection murmur, soft abdomen, healed right knee scar, no lower extremity edema. Blood pressure was elevated.
aux_exam: Auxiliary examination results: EKG was normal, echocardiogram showed low pumping function in the heart, no blockages found in the ER. Blood pressure was elevated but exact value not provided. Ejection fraction percentage not provided.
